EARTH, STONE & MORTAR

EARTH, STONE & MORTAR

Earth, Stone & Mortar is a Derbyshire-based traditional stonework specialist creating bespoke landscapes across the Peak District and beyond. From dry stone walls and natural stone patios to retaining walls, entrance features and complete garden transformations, every project is built with traditional craftsmanship, premium materials and lasting quality.

Projects

Every wall, patio and landscape tells its own story. Explore a collection of bespoke stonework, handcrafted using traditional techniques and premium natural materials across Derbyshire, the Peak District and beyond.

Craftsmanship

Every project begins with an understanding of place, materials and purpose. From traditional dry stone walling to contemporary natural stone landscapes, our work is individually crafted to complement its surroundings and stand the test of time.

ABOUT

EARTH, STONE & MORTAR FOUNDER

LEARN MORE

I founded Earth, Stone & Mortar in 2019 after more than 25 years working in the landscaping industry, with a lifelong passion for natural stone that began on our family farm, where I learnt the traditional craft of dry stone walling.
